homograph.note: The everyday sense (a passport or a contract running out) and the formal sense (a person dying) are far apart for a learner; only the second was tested, so a hint must say which one it targets.

senses.definition: to die; a formal or literary way of saying that a person or animal stops living

examples.en: Two of the injured miners expired before the rescue team arrived.
examples.fa: دو تن از معدنچیان مجروح پیش از رسیدن گروه نجات جان سپردند.

senses.definition: if a document, an agreement or a period of time expires, it reaches its end and is no longer valid

examples.en: My passport expires next spring, so I must renew it soon.
examples.fa: گذرنامه‌ام بهار آینده منقضی می‌شود، پس باید زود تمدیدش کنم.
